race.comment: ROK 'N' ROM (12) couldn't reel in the winner first-up when beaten 1.1L and draws a better gate this time around. Parnham rides now as she remains down in the weights and she'll be fitter for the fresh run. Looks primed to go one better now. WHEELY (8) has trialled nicely coming into this and progressed quickly through the grades. Tsang's claim is a bonus and although he's drawn out, he can storm home and return with a bang. HAVE A CRACK (7) is a newcomer to WA, having raced in NZ before making the trip across. An inside draw is a bonus and his recent trial was very impressive. Drawn the inside for a stable on fire and he can make an impression right away. FINE STAR (4) was solid from midfield first-up and can play a leading role with the added fitness on her side. SNOW GOD (2) not to be discounted coming back in distance.
